Proposal summary: customer portal redesign

We propose a 14-week engagement to redesign the Brightline customer portal. The work falls into three phases: four weeks of research and information architecture, five of visual design and prototyping, and five of front-end implementation.

The fixed fee is $96,000, payable in three installments tied to phase completion. Mr. Okonjo will lead the engagement, with Ms. Reinholt as design lead.

The proposal remains valid until December 15.
